name: How long does it take to install a water feature?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a water feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for a water feature depends on its size, complexity, and site conditions. A simple, small fountain might be installed in a few days. More elaborate custom projects, such as a large pond with filtration or a complex waterfall system, can take several weeks or even a few months from initial groundbreaking to final landscaping and water testing. We provide a projected timeline during the design and proposal phase, taking into account all project specifics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by feature complexity; small fountains may take days, while large custom projects can take several weeks to months.
